slides.title: Content & Typography Overview
slides.content:
# Bootstrap 5 Content & Typography 📄

Before building buttons and interactive cards, your web applications need clean, legible content defaults. Bootstrap provides:

- **Reboot**: A modernized, cross-browser normalization stylesheet
- **Typography**: Standard headings, giant display headings, and lead paragraphs
- **Inline Text Elements**: Badges, marked text, and abbreviations
- **Blockquotes**: Styled quotes with author attributions
- **Responsive Tables**: Striped, bordered, dark, and scrollable tables
- **Responsive Images & Figures**: Thumbnail frames and responsive scaling

slides.title: Bootstrap Reboot: The Base Reset
slides.content:
# Bootstrap Reboot 🔄

**Reboot** is Bootstrap's collection of element-specific CSS changes built on top of Normalize.css.

## Key Reboot Behaviors

1. **`box-sizing: border-box`** is applied globally to every element.
2. **Margins are unidirectional**: Elements only use `margin-bottom` (preventing margin-collapse surprises).
3. **Native System Fonts**: Uses high-performance native system font stacks (`system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto...`).
4. **Root Font Sizing**: Body defaults to `1rem` (16px) with a line-height of `1.5`.
5. **Links**: Underlined on `:hover`, colored with `$link-color`.

slides.title: Data Tables: Basic & Color Variants
slides.content:
# Bootstrap Tables: Core Styling 📊 Add `.table` to any `` tag for clean borders and row padding. ```html_not
# First Last Role
1 Mark Otto @mdo
``` ## Table Color Themes Invert table colors with `.table-dark`, or color individual rows with `.table-primary`, `.table-success`, `.table-danger`, `.table-warning`.

IDUserStatus

102BobPending
```

# Text Alignment & Wrapping Utilities 🔠 Control text placement and line-breaking behavior: ## Alignment Classes - `.text-start` (left in LTR) - `.text-center` - `.text-end` (right in LTR) - Responsive: `.text-center .text-md-start` ## Text Truncation (`.text-truncate`) Truncate long text with an ellipsis on a single line: ```html_not

slides.title: Font Weight & Italics
slides.content:
# Font Weights & Italic Styles 🏋️

Quickly adjust typography emphasis without writing custom CSS rules.

## Font Weights

- `.fw-bold`: `font-weight: 700;`
- `.fw-bolder`: Heavier than parent
- `.fw-semibold`: `font-weight: 600;`
- `.fw-normal`: `font-weight: 400;`
- `.fw-light`: `font-weight: 300;`
- `.fw-lighter`: Lighter than parent

## Font Styles

- `.fst-italic`: `font-style: italic;`
- `.fst-normal`: `font-style: normal;`

slides.title: Line Height Utilities
slides.content:
# Line Height (Leading) Utilities 📏 Control line spacing with `.lh-*`: - `.lh-1`: `line-height: 1;` (great for compact headline badges) - `.lh-sm`: `line-height: 1.25;` - `.lh-base`: `line-height: 1.5;` (body default) - `.lh-lg`: `line-height: 2;` (generous line spacing for long reading) ```html_not

Generously spaced editorial paragraph designed for readability.

```

slides.title: Text Transform & Decoration
slides.content:
# Text Transform & Decoration 🔠

## Text Transform Classes

- `.text-lowercase`: all lowercase
- `.text-uppercase`: ALL CAPS
- `.text-capitalize`: Capitalize Each Word

## Text Decoration

- `.text-decoration-underline`: Adds underline
- `.text-decoration-line-through`: Strikethrough for discounted prices
- `.text-decoration-none`: Strips underlines from links (`<a>`)

slides.title: Accessibility Best Practices for Content
slides.content: # Accessibility (a11y) Best Practices ♿ 1. **Always include `alt` attributes**: ``. 2. **Use `` and ``**: Screen readers need `scope` to associate data cells with headers. 3. **Don't rely solely on color**: Pair colored badges (`.bg-danger`) with descriptive text (e.g. "Error: Payment Failed"). 4. **Visual hidden utilities**: Use `.visually-hidden` for screen-reader-only labels.

slides.title: Summary: Content & Typography
slides.content:
# Content & Typography: Summary 📋

## Key Takeaways
- **Reboot**: Normalizes margins, sets system fonts, and ensures `border-box` sizing.
- **Headings**: Standard `h1`-`h6` plus `.display-1` through `.display-6` for hero text.
- **Lead Text**: `.lead` emphasizes intro paragraphs.
- **Tables**: Combine `.table`, `.table-striped`, `.table-hover`, and `.table-responsive`.
- **Images**: Use `.img-fluid` for responsive scaling and `.img-thumbnail` for gallery cards.
